cases.question: What should a consumer include when disputing an error on a credit report?
cases.reference_answer: Identify each item believed to be wrong, explain why it is inaccurate, include copies of supporting documents, and keep the originals and records of what was sent.
expected_facts: Identify each disputed item and explain why it is wrong.
Include copies of supporting documents and retain the originals and sending records.

cases.question: When should most borrowers receive a Closing Disclosure, and why?
cases.reference_answer: For most mortgages, the lender must provide the Closing Disclosure at least three business days before closing so the borrower can compare it with the Loan Estimate and ask questions.
expected_facts: The lender generally provides the Closing Disclosure at least three business days before closing.
The review period allows comparison with the Loan Estimate and time to ask questions.
